culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Dress modestly in villages, public non-beach areas and places of worship.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Visitors are welcome at Sunday church services (10am): men in shirts and long trousers, women in longer skirts or dresses, preferably with covered shoulders.
culture-and-protocol.note: Churches page covers Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
